Wiley's Wish Animal Rescue is a female and Veteran operated 501(c)3 nonprofit organization dedicated to rescuing dogs from high-kill shelters due to the overcrowding crisis in California. From the Bay to LA, Wiley's Wish aims to rescue, rehabilitate, train and place abandoned, abused, sick and neglected souls stuck behind bars. Since mid-2021, Wiley's has saved and placed over 1,000 dogs into loving, happy homes. 

Wileys' Paws of Hope initiative is an in-house, 3-month long prison/rescue dog training program that spans three prisons, with their respective curriculum, Stripes and Paws Dog Program and Second Chance Dog Program and Unleashed Rescue Academy. Over 350 dogs have successfully graduated from these training programs, AKC and CGC certified. 

To support our rescue and training efforts, please donate! Every dollar helps: https://wileyswish.com/donation
